framework.legal_basis: Directive 2013/34/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 26 June 2013, Annex III (horizontal layout of the balance sheet, Article 10) and Annex V (profit and loss account by nature of expense, Article 13). National formats transpose these Annexes, e.g. Codice civile art. 2424 and 2425 (IT), Plan General de Contabilidad, Real Decreto 1514/2007 (ES), Sistema de Normalização Contabilística (PT), Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 2 Titel 9 and Besluit modellen jaarrekening (NL), Ustawa o rachunkowości załącznik 1 (PL), Årsredovisningslagen (SE), Årsregnskapsloven (DK), Regnskapsloven (NO); EEA states via the EEA Agreement. Switzerland (Obligationenrecht art. 959a/959b) and Moldova (SNC aligned with the Directive) are mapped to this layout by analogy.
